subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What native provenance contract should durable OpenClaw memory use across memory-core, QMD, MEMORY.md promotion, Memory Wiki bridge inputs, and review/edit flows?
rationale: Source inspection shows the gap, but the durable data model, source authority, merge/edit lineage, plugin boundary, and promotion gate are product/API choices that automation should not lock in without maintainer direction.

options.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, source-required promotion, and retrieval/review output before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Schema Foundation First
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 the prerequisite for record and revision ownership, then implement provenance once schema shape is settled.

options.title: Use Memory Wiki As Optional Layer
options.body: Document Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional layer while leaving active memory promotion and retrieval contracts unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical tracker and specify structured source refs, lineage, source-required promotion, and retrieval/review output before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest routing signal for cross-memory host SDK, memory-core state, Memory Wiki docs, and product-boundary decisions in the checked history.
